# Italy Tuscany (ITI1) Crop Fields — EuroCropsV2

Italy, Tuscany field boundaries (2023) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Joint Research Centre, European Commission. License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/it_1/latest/it_1.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/it_1/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:3035; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: collection, geometry, metrics:area, crop:code, id, hcat:name_en, hcat:name, hcat:code, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/it_1/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/it_1/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/it_1/collection.json
